props.title: Over 18 Years of Excellence in Aviation, Tourism & Hospitality Training
“Education is the runway to opportunity. At ITTI, we prepare you to take off.”

props.editor: For over 18 years, ITTI Ghana has delivered industry-aligned training designed to prepare students for real careers in aviation, tourism, hospitality, and customer service. Our programmes focus on practical skill development, global service standards, and strong professional values—ensuring every learner graduates confident, competent, and ready to thrive in today’s competitive service industries.
ITTI aims to promote the highest standards in the delivery of customer service.
To be a world class training center projecting the values of professionalism in the aviation, tourism and hospitality industry.

Passion: The institute has passion as one of its core values and inspires students to love what they do.  

 

Performance: The ability to display Excellence in performance. 

 

Professionalism: bound by our codes of ethics, we exhibit and instil professionalism in our students and staff members.

ITTI made history at the maiden National Aviation Awards in 2016, held under the theme: “Recognising the cream of Ghana’s Aviation Industry.” Endorsed by the Ministry of Transport, this prestigious event brought together local and international industry leaders to honour those setting global benchmarks.

We were pleased to be named the Aviation Institution of the Year, a title we successfully defended in 2017, solidifying our position as West Africa’s premier training hub.

props.blockquote_content: "This award is a major endorsement of what we have been doing—training over 6,000 professionals across every department of airport operations. We ensure our graduates have the professional wings to soar in any organisation."

In 2017, the International Travel & Tourism Institute (ITTI) marked a significant milestone — 10 years of excellence in aviation, hospitality, tourism, and customer service training. Since its launch in July 2007, ITTI has grown into a recognised centre for professional development, equipping individuals with the skills and confidence to succeed in global service industries.

The anniversary celebration brought together alumni, current students, industry partners, consultants, and staff for an open day filled with networking, career guidance, and shared reflections on our journey. Over the past decade, ITTI’s award-winning programmes have produced industry professionals flourishing in airline, hotel, and customer-service roles both in Ghana and internationally.

props.blockquote_content: “Students are trained to understand that their level of success is determined by their level of perseverance and discipline in their course modules. Our students are trained to achieve excellence in service delivery through practical case studies from around the world.”

props.editor: She also shared a powerful insight into the transformation she has seen in ITTI graduates:

props.blockquote_content: “I remember when every session starts; most students are either shy or reserved. But at the end of the session, they come out best, showing eloquence and confidence. This is one achievement we are proud of.”

props.title: We Are Here To Help You With Any Questions You May Have

tabs.tab_title: What programmes does ITTI Ghana offer?
tabs.tab_content: ITTI offers industry-focused training in aviation, travel and tourism, hospitality management, and customer service. Each programme is designed to equip students with practical skills, global service standards, and job-ready knowledge needed to excel in the service industry.

tabs.tab_title: Is ITTI Ghana accredited or affiliated with any organizations?
tabs.tab_content: Yes. ITTI is affiliated with reputable international bodies and partners within the aviation, tourism, and hospitality sectors. These affiliations help align our curricula with global standards and enhance the credibility of our certifications.

tabs.tab_title: Who can enroll in ITTI’s programmes?
tabs.tab_content: Our programmes are open to senior high school graduates, university students, working professionals, and anyone looking to build a career in aviation, tourism, hospitality, or customer service. No prior industry experience is required.

tabs.tab_title: How long do ITTI programmes take to complete?
tabs.tab_content: Programme durations vary depending on the certification type. Most courses run from 6 weeks to 6 months, with flexible schedules designed to accommodate both students and working professionals.

tabs.tab_title: Why choose ITTI Ghana for aviation, tourism, or hospitality training?
tabs.tab_content: ITTI combines practical training, global standards, experienced faculty, and strong industry connections. We focus on professional development, customer service excellence, and hands-on learning — making ITTI one of Ghana’s trusted pathways into aviation, hospitality, and tourism careers.

tabs.tab_title: Do ITTI graduates get job placement or career support?
tabs.tab_content: ITTI provides structured career guidance, internship pathways, and industry exposure through its partnerships. While job placement is not guaranteed, our strong reputation and alumni network significantly improve students’ employment prospects.
